confirmResetBody3: Wasu saƙonnin da aka riga aka karɓa ba za su iya sake ɓoyewa ba saboda an share yanayin zaman Forward Secrecy na gida.
confirmResetFinalBody1: Wannan aikin zai goge har abada asali, adiresoshi da tattaunawar.

sessionDecryptionCacheSubtitle: Sanya maɓallan ɓoye bayanan kwanan nan a cikin RAM kawai yayin buɗewa da buɗe app.Ba a adana wani rubutu mai ƙaranci, kuma ana share cache lokacin da ƙa'idar ke ɓoye, kulle, ainihin ko kalmar wucewa, ko app ɗin ya rufe.
coverLengthLimit: Iyakar tsawon saƙon ɓoye (ciki har da haruffan ɓoye)
wordMismatchRetry: Bambanci ba kalubale. Kuna son sake yunko?
verifyContactCeremonyIntro: Kwatanta waɗannan lambobin tare da {name} ta hanyar kiran murya ko fuska da fuska. Idan dukkanku kuna ganin ƙimar ɗaya, lambar ta gaskiya ce.
verifyContactVerifiedSnackbar: {name} yanzu an yi masa alama a matsayin tabbatacce
verifyContactMismatchTitle: Lambobin ba su yi daidai ba
verifyContactMismatchBody: Idan lambobin ba su yi daidai ba, mabuɗin da ka shigo da shi watakila an gyara shi yayin musayar. Kada ka tabbatar da wannan lambar kuma ka yi la'akari da goge ta da shigowa da ita ta hanyar amintaccen tashar.
verifyContactRevokedSnackbar: {name} ba a sake yi masa alama a matsayin tabbatacce ba
chatUnverifiedBannerBody: Wannan lambar har yanzu ba a tabbatar da ita ba. Har yanzu kana iya musayar saƙonni, amma ba a tabbatar da sahihancin mabuɗin ba.
onboardingIntro: Layergram yana amfani da maɓalli biyu maimakon asusu.Maɓalli na sirri yana tsayawa akan wannan na'urar;Shaida na jama'a shine abin da abokan hulɗa ke amfani da su don ƙara ku.
onboardingGuideHint: Kuna buƙatar jagorar mataki-mataki yayin amfani da app?Bude shi akan wannan na'urar kuma dawo nan idan kun shirya.
onboardingStepCreateBody: Zaɓi wannan idan wannan shine karon farko da kuke amfani da Layergram.
onboardingStepSaveBody: Rubuta shi a takarda kuma kiyaye shi a sirri.Yana kare isa ga ainihin ku.
onboardingStepShareBody: Yi amfani da QR ko mahaɗin don wani ya ƙara ku.
onboardingStepContactBody: Shigo hanyar haɗin su Layergram ko duba QR nasu.
onboardingCreateModeTitle: A karo na farko a nan?Ƙirƙiri sabon ainihi.
onboardingCreateModeBody: Wannan ita ce hanyar al'ada ga sababbin masu amfani.Layergram zai samar muku da sabon maɓalli na sirri da kuma ainihin jama'a gare ku.
onboardingRestoreModeTitle: Maidowa kawai idan kun riga kuna da jumlar dawo da ita.
onboardingRestoreModeBody: Yi amfani da wannan lokacin da kuka ƙirƙiri ainihin Layergram a baya kuma kuna son kawo wannan shaidar akan wannan na'urar.
onboardingCreateHelper: Zaɓi sunan lambobin da za su gani lokacin da kuke raba ainihin jama'a.Kuna iya canza shi daga baya.
onboardingRestoreHelper: Shigar da sunan lambobin da za su gani, sannan liƙa jimlar dawo da ita daga ainihin da kuka ƙirƙira.
recoveryPhraseDialogBody: Waɗannan kalmomi jimlar dawo da ku ce.Za su iya dawo da ainihin Layergram, don haka rubuta su a takarda kafin ci gaba.
recoveryPhraseDialogPrivacyNote: Kar a adana wannan jumlar a cikin hotunan kariyar allo, bayanin kula, fayiloli, ko fayafai na gajimare.Lambobin sadarwa suna buƙatar hanyar haɗin kan jama'a kawai ko QR bayan saitin.
confirmWordBody: Don tabbatar da cewa an kwafi kalmar daidai, Layergram yana neman kalma ɗaya daga gare ta.
identityCreatedBody: Nan gaba zaku ga My Identity.Raba QR ko mahaɗin daga wannan shafin don wani ya ƙara ku, sannan ƙara ainihin su daga shafin Lambobin sadarwa.
identityCreatedPublicKeyNote: Raba bayanan jama'a yana da aminci.Kada ku taɓa raba jumlar dawo da abin da kuka rubuta kawai.
shareAndroidWhatsAppWarning: Idan saƙon ya bayyana an yanke shi a WhatsApp, yi amfani da "Kwafi" kuma manna shi da hannu.
shareAndroidWhatsAppDialogContent: WhatsApp yana cire rubutun da aka raba. Buɗe WhatsApp ka manna saƙon da hannu don aika shi cikakken.
shareAndroidTelegramDialogContent: Telegram yana cire haruffan faɗin zero, wanda yana cire saƙon Layergram na ɓoye. Ana ba da shawarar raba ta wannan app.
security.fs.warning.recoverability: Idan ka rasa damar yin amfani da wannan na'urar, ba za a iya dawo da saƙon da ke ƙarƙashin Sirri na Gaba ba.
security.fs.warning.device_bound: Matsakaicin Sirrin Gaba yana danganta wannan tattaunawar zuwa na'urar ku ta yanzu. Canja na'urorin zasu buƙaci sake kafa zaman.
security.fs.warning.pending_activation: Haɓaka Sirrin Gaba yana jiran. Aika sako don kammala musafaha.
security.fs.warning.fallback_allowed: Sakonnin Sirrin Gaba suna amfani da ratchet kawai. Ba a kwafe su da tsohon makullin shaida ba.
security.fs.warning.no_silent_downgrade: Matsakaicin Sirrin Gaba yana aiki. Ba za a iya aika saƙonni ba tare da tabbataccen tashar tashar ba.
security.fs.new_device_detected: Sabuwar na'ura ko zaman da aka gano don wannan lambar sadarwa. Ana yin shawarwarin sabon zaman tsaro.
security.fs.message_lost: An rufaffen wannan saƙon tare da zaman da ya gabata kuma ba za a iya ɓarɓare shi ba.
security.message_not_for_me: Ba a sami saƙon Layergram da za'a iya yankewa ba.
security.fs.session_reset_done: Amintaccen sake saitin zaman. Za a yi shawarwarin sabon zama ta atomatik.
security.fs.error.session_broken: Wannan amintaccen zaman ya karye kuma ba za a iya amfani da shi ba.
security.fs.error.device_repair_required: Matsakaicin Sirrin Gaba yana buƙatar gyara na'urar kafin aikawa.
security.fs.error.unexpected_device: An gano na'urar da ba a zata ba. Gyara amintaccen zaman kafin aikawa.
security.fs.error.sending_blocked: Matsakaicin Sirrin Gaba yana hana aikawa a halin yanzu.
security.fs.info.title: Tsaro tare da wannan lamba
security.fs.info.legacy_description: An rufaffen saƙonni daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe. Sirrin Gaba zai kunna ta atomatik yayin da kuke musayar saƙonni.
security.fs.info.active_description: Sirrin Gaba yana aiki. Kowane saƙo yana amfani da maɓalli na musamman da aka samo daga musafaha na yau da kullun.
security.fs.info.active_advantage: Saƙonnin da suka gabata suna da kariya ko da an lalatar da maɓallan ku daga baya.
security.fs.info.strict_description: Matsakaicin Sirrin Gaba yana aiki kuma yana ɗaure ga wannan na'urar. Ana iya aika saƙonni da karɓa kawai ta wannan tasha mai tsaro da aka tabbatar.
security.fs.info.broken_description: An kasa tabbatar da amintaccen tashar. Babu wani sako da aka aika ko karba a wannan jihar.
security.fs.info.upgrading_description: Sirrin Gaba yana haɓakawa ta atomatik. Ci gaba da musayar saƙonni don kammala amintaccen zaman.
security.fs.maximum.confirm_body: Wannan zai ɗaure tattaunawar zuwa na'urar ku ta yanzu. Kuna buƙatar maimaita wannan tsari idan kun canza na'urori.
security.fs.maximum.pending_notice: Jiran {contact} don tabbatar da Babban Sirri na Gaba.
security.fs.maximum.disable_confirm_body: Saƙonni da wannan lamba za su koma Advanced FS. Za ka iya kunna Maximum FS daga baya, amma dole ne ka sake tabbatar da tashar tsaro.
security.fs.maximum.setup_outgoing_body: Wannan zai aika saƙon saiti kawai. Rubutun saƙonka zai zauna a nan. Ku rika musayar saƙonnin saiti bi-da-bi har sai Maximum FS ta kunna, sannan ka sake aika saƙonka.
security.fs.maximum.setup_incoming_body: Wannan saƙon saiti ne kawai. Ku rika musayar saƙonnin saiti bi-da-bi har sai Maximum FS ta kunna. Ba a aika rubutun saƙo ba tukuna.
security.fs.info.legacy_advantages: Matsakaicin dacewa tare da duk na'urorin ku. Yana aiki a kan na'urori da yawa a lokaci guda. Gabatar da Sirri yana inganta ta atomatik lokacin da aka goyan baya.
security.fs.info.legacy_keep_in_mind: Har yanzu waɗannan saƙonnin ba su da kariya ta Sirrin Gaba. Haɓakawa yana faruwa ta atomatik yayin da kuke musayar saƙonni.
security.fs.info.upgrading_advantages: Yana inganta kariya ta atomatik. Yana kiyaye dacewa a duk na'urorin ku.
security.fs.info.upgrading_keep_in_mind: Sirrin Gaba yana aiki ne kawai bayan an kafa amintaccen zaman. Wannan yana faruwa ta atomatik ta hanyar musayar saƙonni.
security.fs.info.active_keep_in_mind: Idan wannan lambar sadarwar ta canza na'urar ko ta sake shigar da Layergram, ana iya buƙatar sabon amintaccen zaman.
security.fs.info.strict_advantages: Mafi ƙarfi kariya ga wannan lamba. Yana hana rage girman shiru don saƙonnin mai amfani.
security.fs.info.strict_keep_in_mind: Idan kowane mutum ya canza na'ura, ya sake shigar da Layergram, ko ya rasa yanayin zaman, aikawa zai iya tsayawa har sai an gyara zaman. Wasu tsoffin saƙonnin ƙila ba za a iya dawo dasu ba.
security.fs.info.strict_requested_descri: Kun nemi Babban Sirri na Gaba don wannan lambar sadarwa. Har yanzu bai fara aiki ba - Layergram yana jiran tabbataccen zaman zaman.
security.fs.info.strict_requested_advant: Yana shirya wannan lambar sadarwa don mafi ƙarfi yanayin daure na'urar.
security.fs.info.strict_requested_keep_i: Ya kamata ku da wannan lambar sadarwa ta yarda ku yi amfani da na'urar da ake tsammani. Wataƙila ba za a iya karanta saƙon daga wasu na'urori ba har sai an kafa sabon zaman amintaccen zaman.
security.fs.info.broken_keep_in_mind: Gyara ko sake kafa amintaccen zaman kafin aikawa.
security.fs.info.suspended_description: Ba za a iya amfani da zaman Tsararren Gaba na baya ba a halin yanzu. Layergram na iya sake gwada shawarwari.
security.fs.info.suspended_keep_in_mind: Aika sako don jawo sabon ingantaccen haɓaka zaman zaman.
security.fs.progress.one_more_exchange: Karin musayar saƙo guda ɗaya don kunnawa
security.fs.progress.exchanges_remaining: Game da musayar saƙon {n} don kunnawa
security.fs.warning.recoverability_title: Wataƙila ba za a iya karanta wasu saƙonni daga baya ba
security.fs.warning.recoverability_body: Wannan yanayin yana inganta kariya ta rage tsawon lokacin da tsofaffin maɓallai ko tarihin karantawa suka kasance. Idan ka share saƙonni, sake saita zaman, sake shigar da Layergram, ko share rufaffen ma'ajiyar bayanai, wasu tsoffin saƙonnin ƙila ba za a iya dawo dasu ba koda kuwa har yanzu kana da madaidaicin kalmar wucewa.
security.fs.warning.recoverability_confi: Na fahimci cewa wasu tsoffin saƙonni na iya zama ba za a iya murmurewa ba.
security.fs.warning.device_bound_title: Wannan yanayin yana daure ga ingantattun na'urori
security.fs.warning.device_bound_body: Yi amfani da shi kawai idan kai da wannan lambar sadarwa sun yarda don amfani da na'urar da ake tsammanin. Idan kowane mutum ya canza na'ura, ya sake shigar da Layergram, sake saita zaman, ko yayi amfani da tsohuwar siga, saƙonnin bazai iya karantawa ba har sai an kafa sabon zaman amintaccen.
security.fs.warning.device_bound_confirm: Na yarda da wannan tare da lambar sadarwa kuma na fahimci cewa wannan yanayin yana da alaƙa da na'ura.
security.fs.warning.pending_body: Matsakaicin FS bai aiki tukuna. Layergram yana jiran tabbataccen zaman zaman. Har zuwa tabbatarwa, har yanzu wannan lambar ba ta amfani da Babban Sirri na Gaba.
security.fs.warning.fallback_body: An kashe tsohon fallback na FS. Idan tsohon sako yana da kayan fallback, Layergram ba zai yi amfani da shi ba sai da zaman FS mai dacewa.
security.fs.device.unknown: Zaman da ba a sani ba
security.fs.card.title: Tsaro ga wannan mahallin
security.fs.card.no_sessions: Babu zama mai aiki tare da wannan lambar sadarwa.
security.fs.card.explanation_prefix: Sirrin Gaba yana kunna ta atomatik yayin da kuke musayar saƙonni. Yana kare saƙonnin da aka aika kawai bayan kafa amintaccen zaman. Saƙonnin da aka aika kafin wannan haɓakawa sun kasance suna da kariya ta tsarin ɓoye Layergram na baya.
security.passphrase.fs_inactive: Mahallin kalmar wucewa ba ya aiki
security.passphrase.settings_visible_not: Waɗannan saitunan suna samuwa kawai yayin da mahallin kalmar wucewar ku ke aiki.
security.fs.mode.sheet_subtitle: Zaɓi matakin Sirrin Gaba don wannan lambar sadarwa.
security.fs.mode.advanced_desc: Sirrin Gaba kai tsaye idan ana goyon baya. Babu tsohon fallback na abun ciki.
security.fs.mode.strict_desc: Kariya mafi ƙarfi. Daure na'ura, babu koma baya.
security.fs.cls.legacy.desc: Wannan saƙon yana amfani da daidaitaccen ɓoye sirrin Layergram. Sirrin Gaba ba ya aiki.
security.fs.cls.pre_fs.desc: An aika wannan saƙon kafin a kafa Sirri na Gaba kuma FS ba shi da kariya.
security.fs.cls.negotiation.desc: Wannan saƙon wani bangare ne na shawarwarin musafaha na Sirrin Gaba.
security.fs.cls.fs_fallback.desc: Wannan tsohon sako ya kunshi kayan fallback na da kuma ba a dauke shi a matsayin cikakken Sirrin Gaba ba.
security.fs.cls.fs_only.desc: Sirrin Gaba kawai yana kiyaye wannan saƙon. Ba za a iya ɓoye shi da maɓallin gado ba.
security.fs.cls.strict.desc: Babban Sirrin Gaba yana kiyaye wannan saƙon. An kashe koma baya na gado.
security.fs.cls.failed.desc: Ƙaddamar da Sirri na Gaba ya kasa. Wataƙila an sake saita zaman ko an canza na'urar.
security.fs.cls.unknown.desc: An kasa tantance matakin tsaro na wannan sakon.
security.pp.section_subtitle: Saituna na musamman ga wannan asalin kalmar wucewa.
security.pp.timeout_title: Fitar da kalmar wucewa ta atomatik
security.pp.timeout_subtitle: Zaɓi ɗan gajeren lokaci don ƙarin kariya mai ƙarfi.
security.pp.screen_lock_subtitle: Rusa maɓallan kalmar wucewa nan da nan lokacin da allon ya kulle.
security.warn.active_passphrase: Yayin da aka buɗe wannan shaidar, maɓallan sa suna cikin ƙwaƙwalwar na'urar. Layergram baya karewa daga kamawa ko daidaitawa yayin da ainihin ke buɗewa.
security.warn.passphrase_fs: Kalmar wucewa ta dawo da wannan ainihi. Maiyuwa ba zai dawo da tsoffin saƙonni amintattu ba idan yanayin zaman da ake buƙata ya share ko ya ƙare.
security.warn.volatile_history: An tsara wannan yanayin don rage farfadowa na gaba. Wataƙila ba za a sake karanta tsoffin saƙonni ba, har ma da madaidaicin kalmar wucewa.
security.warn.ephemeral_session: Jihar FS da tarihi RAM-kawai ne. FS yana sake farawa bayan kowace korar kalmar wucewa. Babu wani sako ko yanayin zaman da zai tsira.
security.warn.recoverability_body: Wannan yanayin yana inganta kariya ta rage tsawon lokacin da tsofaffin maɓallai ko tarihin karantawa suka kasance. Idan ka share saƙonni, sake saita zaman, korar wannan shaidar, sake shigar da Layergram, rasa jihar gida, ko share rufaffen tarihin, wasu tsofaffin saƙonnin na iya zama ba za a iya dawo dasu ba koda kuwa har yanzu kana da ainihin rubutun Layergram ko madaidaicin kalmar wucewa.
security.warn.recoverability_confirm: Na fahimci cewa wasu tsoffin saƙonni na iya zama ba za a iya murmurewa ba.
security.cleanup.title: Tsaftace bayanan da ba za a iya ɓoyewa ba
security.cleanup.subtitle: Cire sauran bayanan da ba za a iya ɓoye su ba.
security.cleanup.dialog_title: Tsaftace bayanan da ba za a iya ɓoyewa ba
security.cleanup.dialog_body: Wannan na iya goge tsoffin rumbun adana bayanan da aka yi watsi da su, bayanan sirri da aka yi watsi da su, bayanan da aka samu daga kalmar wucewa, zaman tsaro, da sauran bayanan da Layergram ba zai iya rusa su ba a halin yanzu.
security.cleanup.confirm_checkbox: Na fahimci wannan aikin ba zai iya jurewa ba.
security.cleanup.done: An goge bayanan da ba a iya ɓoyewa.
identityQrActionHint: Matsa ko dogon danna QR don rabawa ko adana shi azaman hoto.
identityQrActionsSubtitle: Wannan hoton ya ƙunshi ainihin jama'a kawai.Yi amfani da takardar tsarin don adana shi zuwa Hotuna ko Fayiloli, ko aika shi.
excludeFromBackupsShort: Sabbin saƙonni a wannan tattaunawar ba za su shiga ajiyar kwafin Layergram a kan abokan ciniki na hukuma ba.
excludeFromBackupsCaveat: Ba ya hana hoton allo, rikodin allo, abokan ciniki da aka gyara, ko kwafe na waje.
touchComposerExcludeFromBackupsOn: Cirewa daga ajiyar kwafi ya kunna
touchComposerExcludeFromBackupsOff: Cirewa daga ajiyar kwafi ya kashe
